verdict.rationale: This axis applies: an agent platform could plausibly host or integrate partner-built agent apps. However, the evidence shows no marketplace or partner app ecosystem inside Devin. What it does document runs the other way: Devin integrates into Slack, Jira and CI tools, exposes itself via MCP, and ships a Handoff plugin so other agents can hand work to Devin. None of that lets a lead bring third-party agent apps into Devin workflows.
